summary: two sibling nodes have identical text
help: Rename one of the nodes, or merge them.
rationale: Two identical branches render as indistinguishable children, which is usually a copy-paste mistake.

help: Add at least one node line below the header.
rationale: The diagram parses, but it renders empty.

summary: mindmap node is nested more than five levels deep
help: Flatten the branch, or split it into a separate diagram.
rationale: Deep nesting is a matter of taste, so this rule is off by default.
